snippet.title: What If RuneScape Was a Survival Roguelike? | RogueScape Trailer
snippet.description:
RogueScape is an old-school MMO-inspired survival roguelike where every run starts with a build choice.

Pick your skills, survive escalating waves, open chests, level up, and turn permanent account progress into stronger future runs. Build around combat, gathering, production, and support skills as you fight through 20-minute runs filled with tougher enemies, mini-boss pressure, and powerful synergies.

Wishlist RogueScape on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4793330/RogueScape/

Request playtest access on Steam and follow the game for updates.

#RogueScape #IndieGame #Roguelike #SurvivalRoguelike #BulletHeaven #PixelArt #SteamGames #IndieDev 

RogueScape is not affiliated with Jagex or RuneScape.
